its answer is the order of two processes: it runs system(icont || " x.icn &>foo.out"), and /bin/sh (dash) reads &> as & then >, so icont starts in the background and its error sh: 1: icont: not found reaches stderr whenever that job runs, while the program prints ...done on stdout; the contract merges the two streams, so the ref pins a race no implementation is bound to win, and it also turns on icont being absent from PATH. MEASURED: unicon 13.3 20 of 20 and 10 of 10 in the ref's order; SCRIP 8746c169c by hand 9 of 12 and 335ab09ed 8 of 10, the rest the other order; the harness, mode 3, PASS 1 of 3 (the cqo, officer_12 2026-11-16)
